evidence: ### Duncan Bay to Nydia Bay campsite (4 hr)
### Nydia Lodge turn-off to Kaiuma Bay (4 hr)
The track then climbs a little into the forest and sidles around to a point above Kaiuma Bay, before dropping to the car park.
The track starts at the road end and carpark at Duncan Bay.
Travel 21 km to the track start on the roadside marked with a large sign.

access_points.quote: Another option is to take a boat to Shag Point, 4 km from the track end at Kaiuma.

access_points.name: Nydia Bay (by boat)
access_points.quote: take passengers from Havelock to Shag Point, Nydia Bay or Duncan Bay

not_on_route.name: Tennyson Inlet
not_on_route.quote: take in the great views of Tennyson Inlet

doubts: The Kaiuma end is described as 'the car park' / 'the track start on the roadside marked with a large sign'; F3 (Nydia Track meets Kaiuma Bay Road) is taken as it. The Shag Point and Nydia Bay boat access points do not say which track they join (Shag Point is 4 km from the Kaiuma track end). Nydia Lodge is a 30 min walk from the turn-off, so it is treated as off the way. The Tennyson Inlet view ref is the coast entry; the page also uses 'Tennyson Inlet end' for the Duncan Bay road end.
